{{Top|leg}}
'''Anti-laser aerosol''' was a form of laser-blocking artificial cloud cover. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] first employed this tactic at the [[Battle of Paarin Minor]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was in turn used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]] in the final days of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> The [[Fire Breather]], used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion of the galaxy]], exhaled a form of anti-laser aerosol.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>
